title: agsc.config.json
description: The single configuration file of a Bundle (AGSC-01-17). Configuration is CLOSED: additionalProperties is false and an unknown top-level key is error AGSC-E004 (AGSC-01-18), except the x-<vendor>-<key> forward-compatibility namespace (docs/SPEC.md §8(2)), admitted by patternProperties and preserved verbatim. There is no second configuration file. CC0-1.0.

base.description: Absolute https origin, trailing slash optional and stripped; the IRI base of every item (AGSC-01-19). The development placeholder http://localhost[:port]/ written by adoption (AGSC-02-94) is accepted and lint-warned as AGSC-E506 until the owner sets a real base. No query, no fragment, and no path segment that is . or .. (rc.5).

analytics_token.description: Edge analytics token only. No beacon, cookie or third-party script may be emitted (AGSC-06-05).

tdm_crawlers.description: RFC 9309 product tokens of the crawlers whose operators state that they collect content in order to train a machine-learning model. The writer emits one User-agent/Disallow: / group per token (AGSC-06-18, rc.6); a node publishing a TDM reservation with an empty list is AGSC-E202 at build. The list is the publisher's and is never a constant of this specification.

base.description: Vocabulary hash namespace; the site domain MUST NOT appear here (AGSC-05-02).

releases.description: Boolean switchboard; an item with release: <key> publishes only when its key is true (AGSC-01-20).

allowed.description: The closed tag vocabulary; a tag outside it is AGSC-E203 (AGSC-01-21).

build.description: rdfxml and feed are RESERVED names of 1.1 and are rejected here with AGSC-E004 (AGSC-00-20, AGSC-01-18; feed reserved at rc.5 — no 1.0 rule pins the bytes of /feed.xml).

out.description: Build output directory; a relative path under the grammar of AGSC-01-35, one or more /-separated segments, a trailing slash accepted and stripped (AGSC-01-19; multi-segment admitted at rc.5).

default.description: BCP 47 tag of the primary (unsuffixed) files; default en.

peers.description: Federation peers (AGSC-10-12): each entry is another node's canonical /.well-known/knowledge-linkset URL, emitted as one .../rel#peer link in the link set (AGSC-06-10).

run.description: Opt-in execution settings for the run and trace verbs (AGSC-09-94). Both verbs exit 2 with AGSC-E001 unless enabled is true.

allow.description: Program names permitted as the first word of a {run} block; anything else is refused.

channels.description: Registered ingest channels (AGSC-01-30..33). allow[] and rate{per_hour} are the only keys admitted after the 1.0.0-rc.2 freeze. name is unique; author is the forge identity CI checks the PR author against, owner is the accountable human whose publish choice AGSC-08-26 treats as standing approval.

author.description: Forge login of the identity that opens ingest pull requests (AGSC-08-26 c).

publish.description: Default hitl; auto merges only under AGSC-08-26.

allow.description: OPTIONAL sender allow-list: the ingest job rejects a message whose sender is absent from a non-empty list; an absent or empty array accepts every sender (AGSC-01-30).

per_hour.description: Maximum messages ingested from this channel per hour; the job stops for the hour at the bound and records the skipped messages by sources[].id (AGSC-01-33).

injection_patterns.description: Literal alternations only, never user-supplied regular expressions (AGSC-08-13).

federation.description: AGSC-11-01/11-06/11-09 walk parameters; defaults hop_limit 3, fan_out 50, max_requests 500, redirect_limit 3, timeout_ms 10000; any value up to the maximum is admitted (AGSC-E209 beyond it).

max_bytes.description: AGSC-11-10(f), rc.5: the cap on any cross-origin artefact other than a discovery document, measured on the decoded stream; AGSC-E907 at the bound.

chunks.description: AGSC-11-01; chunk export bound (rules in §06 at rc.3).

contribute.description: AGSC-11-14 contribute targets published as rel#contribute links; the mode fixes the target form (oneOf). A node's own configuration is closed (AGSC-11-02 tolerance applies to received documents only).

visibility.description: AGSC-11-20. Closed for a node's own configuration; the AGSC-11-02 most-restrictive reading (restricted) applies only to a discovery document a reader did not author.

surfaces.description: AGSC-11-16/11-21 declaration-only surfaces (responder, solid, a2a-card): target, external version and access class, which cannot be derived from emitted bytes. Built-in surfaces (llms-txt, chunks, mcp, webmcp) are derived and never listed here.

version.description: AGSC-11-21, rc.5: a responder names its protocol, mcp:<revision> or a2a:<version>; a bare SemVer is not a protocol name.

related.description: AGSC-06-35 related-system links carried in the discovery document: IANA-registered relations only; ignored by readers that do not understand them; never affect conformance, digests or the walk.

budget.description: Node-wide monthly cap on model spend of every kind, in USD (AGSC-01-38, rc.4); the enabled agents' budget_usd_month sum must not exceed it (AGSC-E212). Overridable as AGSC_BUDGET_USD_MONTH (AGSC-01-37).

agents.description: Agent-lane declarations (AGSC-01-36, rc.4). A lane runs only as refresh --agent <name> or as a declared client of the tool server / page tools, and writes only Proposals through its channel (AGSC-08-28..30). Disabled by default.

author.description: Forge login under which the lane's Proposals are opened; must equal channels[].author of the named channel (AGSC-01-36).

model.description: Model identifier; REQUIRED when kind is llm (AGSC-01-36).

types.description: Item types the lane may touch; default all three; a procedure, gate or cluster is never admitted (AGSC-08-26 b).

schedule.description: Opaque to the format; interpreted by the host's scheduler.

budget_usd_month.description: REQUIRED when kind is llm; the lane stops for the month at the bound (AGSC-08-28 e).

max_new_items.description: Greatest number of items one Proposal of the lane may create (AGSC-08-28 c; AGSC-E511).

max_claims.description: Greatest number of tasks the lane may hold in TASK_STATE_WORKING at once — the work-in-progress limit (AGSC-10-17; AGSC-E511).

then.description: AGSC-01-36: model is REQUIRED when kind is llm and ABSENT otherwise (rc.5).

single_line.description: AGSC-02-24 as amended at rc.5: an AUTHORED SINGLE-LINE string. It MUST NOT carry a C0 control (U+0000-U+001F), U+007F, U+0085, U+2028 or U+2029, because a writer puts it on a LINE of a line-oriented text surface (/llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /now.md, the Harness files, llms-ctx.txt, robots.txt, _headers, _redirects, /.well-known/security.txt) where a line break creates a new line, a forged heading or a forged header. A violation is AGSC-E204 (spec/09 section 9.4 precedence: every pattern violation takes that code). The class is a negated character class with no lookahead, no back-reference and no quantifier-based bound, so it is the ECMA-262 dialect JSON Schema 2020-12 names and transliterates mechanically to the \x{...} escapes of RE2, Go and Rust. A writer additionally NEUTRALISES these code points when it interpolates such a string (knowledge/unicode.js#singleLine), so a Bundle that never passed validation still cannot inject structure.

human_actor.description: AGSC-01-25: the accountable operator of this Bundle, human:<id> only; the first source of prov.operator at adoption (AGSC-02-90).
